meta.description: Thin-wall GCR response kernel R=D_organ/Phi_ff, cal_material=polyethylene. Regenerated by lunarsim.kernel_gen.
meta.quantity: R = D_organ / Phi_ff  (Gy*cm^2); q in D=absorbed, I=ICRP-60 dose-eq
meta.note: COMPOSITION=corrected: H/He/C/Si/Fe matching dosimetry.GCR_COMPOSITION (doc 2.3). Si (Z=14) is the Z=10-20 (Ne-Ca) group representative, replacing the committed kernel's O. Fe is regridded to the 6-node C/Si grid [180-5000 MeV/n] from the committed 3-node [400-1000], which folded only ~31% of the Fe GCR fluence. H/He/C transport is identical to the committed kernel (--validate confirms); Si and Fe are new MC. CAL_MATERIAL=polyethylene (G4_POLYETHYLENE, rho=0.94 g/cm^3): hydrogen-rich wall kernel on the Al areal grid [2.025/10/50 g/cm^2], shell geometry. Compared tool-vs-itself against the aluminium kernel at identical areal density (target-blind); not confined to the thin EVA band.
